original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 11 record's declared OEM-string Count equals the number of strings in that record, matches the approved OEM content policy and remains stable after reboot without exposing unapproved string contents.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 11 structures and string sets, preserve the declared count byte, enumerate exactly the record-local strings through the double-NUL boundary, apply approved redaction/content policy and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves expected count/content patterns, multiple-record handling, evidence redaction and reboot plan. No OEM-string write is part of this case.
required_inputs: Expected Type 11 count or approved OEM-string inventory/pattern
Policy for multiple Type 11 structures, empty strings, duplicates and ordering
Classification/redaction rules for asset, provisioning or credential-like content
Controlled evidence location and access policy
Section-aware parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not write OEM strings or firmware.
Scope Count to each Type 11 record and independently enumerate its complete string set; never use an unscoped grep as acceptance evidence.
Redact or hash sensitive strings according to the approved policy while retaining enough identity to compare persistence.
Treat malformed termination, count/list mismatch and additional trailing strings as distinct errors.
Stop on secret exposure, malformed boundaries, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse each Type 11 record boundary, compare declared count with record-local enumeration, apply approved redaction and compare controlled pre/post-reboot evidence.
Do not disclose secrets, write OEM data or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected count/content, multi-record semantics and redaction policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, review any count/content anomaly and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `grep Count` is not section-safe, can match unrelated fields and captures neither the full string set nor proof that its size equals the declared byte.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive controlled raw/decoded Type 11 records, parse each record boundary and emit declared count, enumerated count, per-string redacted identity and termination validity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 11 Count scope, source script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a record-boundary-aware parser to compare the raw Count byte with the exact number of local strings, validate termination and preserve policy-controlled hashes/redactions for content and reboot comparison.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS and parser/dmidecode versions plus evidence-redaction policy revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 11 Count and string-set layout, approved OEM content/security policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unscoped grep with raw count/list consistency and controlled complete-record evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage by detecting malformed termination, hidden/trailing strings, multi-record confusion and sensitive-data leakage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM strings are vendor-defined and may contain sensitive provisioning data; their meaning cannot be inferred without platform policy.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve count changes only with a versioned OEM-string content policy and must record redacted old/new identities; it cannot waive internal count/list consistency.
expected_evidence: Approved expected count/content, multi-record/ordering rules and sensitive-string policy
Controlled pre-reboot raw Type 11 structures with declared count, enumerated count and termination result
Redacted or hashed per-string identities sufficient for authorized comparison
Approved reboot/health evidence and controlled post-reboot count/list diff
Engineer verdict without unauthorized plaintext disclosure

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 11 Count field and record-local string list provide a coherent, directly testable intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Count and list integrity are safely parseable; missing OEM content or redaction policy is execution readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects unscoped matching and adds declared-versus-enumerated integrity and redaction.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains section/security safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates owner policy and engineer verdict from software execution capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible Count line from passing when the actual string list is malformed or belongs to another record, and protects sensitive OEM evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The raw count byte and record-local NUL-terminated string set are deterministically parseable; policy-controlled comparison is fully automatable.
